description: Image Description: The image shows an old-fashioned, boxy CRT television placed on a paved surface composed of rectangular stone tiles arranged in a herringbone pattern. The TV is positioned at an angle, with its screen facing slightly upward and toward the viewer. The screen is turned off and displays a uniform grayish-green hue typical of inactive cathode-ray tube displays. The television has a black frame with a silver or metallic side panel on the left.
